quest.title: Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl!
quest.description: You and Paimon have been feeling pretty good recently, so you're thinking about taking on some more commissions from the Adventurers' Guild! Little did you expect, however, to run into some Arataki Gang members openly scheming nearby...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

talks.objective: Listen in on the Arataki Gang's discussion

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: C'mon, Boss, you can't just let this one slide!

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: You've painstakingly built up a reputation as the "Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King." You can't let that brat get away scot-free!

dialogues.speaker: Akira
dialogues.text: Yeah! That little punk must have used some underhanded trick to catch you off guard, I just know it!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey, hey, chill, boys, chill. Relax!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I just underestimated my opponent. And can you blame me, with how boring the kid looked? So yeah, no worries, that fight didn't count!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Anyway, enough about that. We're gonna stick to the plan, alright? The "Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl" is going ahead. Then, we'll bring out "Crimson Staff." Y'know, the one I've been training for years!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Just imagine it. The whole audience cheering me on as Crimson Staff gets ready to crush its opponent...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: That kiddo will be trembling with fear. No tricks this time, no sir — just an easy win for Itto! Ahahahahahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: Alright, boss, way to go!

dialogues.speaker: Akira
dialogues.text: But we don't know when Shinobu's coming back. Where do we even start with organizing the Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl?

dialogues.speaker: Akira
dialogues.text: Based on our experience with the Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival, we'll need to register the event with the Tenryou Commission and obtain a permit... and I think we also need proof of a venue rental.

dialogues.speaker: Akira
dialogues.text: We're going to need to pay for all of that stuff somehow. If we want the Extreme Brawl to be even more extravagant than the Drumalong Festival, we'll need to spend at least three times the Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Stop, stop, stop! We don't say "Tenryou Commission," out loud, okay? It gives me migraines!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: So we need some funds, huh... Easy — just need to tweak our three-day weekend policy. As well as our one-day week policy. Let's work flat out and do two days on, four days off! That way, we work an extra four days between us, which means we'll earn four times as much. We'll be raking in the Mora!

dialogues.speaker: Akira
dialogues.text: Amazing, Boss! Then all we need to figure out is how to make up the numbers for our team! And it doesn't matter who we pick, because you're practically a one-man army!

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: ...Shoot, that's right! That brat said that he'll be bringing five of his top guys to fight us fair and square. But Boss, you're the only one in our gang who's any good at beetle fighting...

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: If they come at you in waves, you're gonna have a hard time no matter how good you are!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Come on, you two! It's a little early to be getting cold feet. You're thinking too many steps ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Where's your Arataki Gang attitude? Come on, I'll find a way to deal with this, easy-peasy lavender-melon-squeezy!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Maybe I can hit up my usual beetle-fighting crowd... Or maybe I can visit Naganohara Fireworks and see if I can rope that gal into it...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: ...Scratch that. If I did that, then news of me losing to that brat would spread around Hanamizaka! Ugh. My reputation would never recover...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: True! So, Bull-Chucker, what are you up to this time?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Gah! You scared me! When'd you get here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seriously? We've been standing here for ages!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We were heading to the Adventurers' Guild, but then we saw you causing a commotion and talking about your next hare-brained event idea...

choices.text: "Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King"?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hey, hey, hey! Don't forget the "Extreme" part. Can't do without the coolest bit of the name, y'know?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Compadre, you'll understand my passion for beetle fighting eventually. You just need more practice!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahh, so you're looking for a way to recover your pride after a humiliating defeat, are you?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: What? No! Come on, it's not like that! I was ambushed! Ambushed, I'm tellin' ya!

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: That's right. Some poser calling himself "Grandmaster Hanakado" challenged the Boss in a brief moment of exhaustion after an intense beetle battling session.

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: He used a ridiculously huge Onikabuto and flipped Boss's beetle over in a matter of seconds.

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: And then he said something like, "Welcome to the world of real beetle-fighters"...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Mamoru, Mamoru! Easy on the details, my dude!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I think I understand the situation now...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Anyway, compadre, I've heard that you're talented at pretty much everything. You pick up new skills almost instantly, and before you know it, you're a pro...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon knows what you're going to say next, Bull-Chucker!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're going to ask us to avenge you and defeat that "Grandmaster Hanakado" for free, aren't you?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: For free? Flying Lavender Melon, do you really think that I, Arataki Itto, have no code of honor?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Listen, compadre. If you do this for me, I'll buy you both lunch for the next two months. One bowl of signature ramen every day for two whole months! How's that sound?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: One bowl every day? Ooh, now that's an offer worth considering...

choices.text: Why are you being so generous?

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: Hahaha! That's the result of Boss's hard-won victory.

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: Some little phony was going around calling himself the "Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King," and Boss couldn't put up with that. So Boss challenged him and said whoever wins gets the title.

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: After 92 brutal rounds of beetle-battling that lasted one full day and night, the Boss finally emerged victorious!

choices.text: Why do I get the feeling that...

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: But the kid offered Boss a "One Free Bowl of Ramen Daily" coupon from his family's ramen stall in exchange for giving the title back in two months.

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: We don't know how good his family's ramen is, but the sheer quantity being offered made it too good to refuse.

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: Besides, Boss's beetle-fighting techniques are improving so fast that he'll easily have won a more impressive title by two months from now. It's a great deal!

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: The only slight snag is, we forgot to ask him where the ramen stall is...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ahem! Shh! Shh! Don't sweat the details! Anyway, compadre, Flying Lavender Melon, that's my offer! All that ramen, just for you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait! We haven't agreed yet!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: I've already challenged this "Grandmaster" kid, and he accepted. He's going to bring some reinforcements with him to face off against us.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: As for the venue, I think I have an idea. But first, compadre, Imma need you to do me a solid and sort out all the pesky paperwork at the Tenryou Commission!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Sound good? Good. Alright then, my compadre and melon duo, let's hop to it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sheesh. Itto sure seems excited about all this. Guess there's no backing out now, huh... We might as well go along with this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We just have to learn how to beetle fight and help him beat his opponents, right? Sounds simple enough!

choices.text: Signature ramen, here we come!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, listen to you! Is Bull-Chucker's childishness really that infectious? Because one Itto is more than enough!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After dealing with the Tenryou Commission's pesky paperwork, you head to the venue that Itto mentioned...

choices.text: We'll be pro-nikabutos in no time!
...His opponent simply ran out of patience?
Did you finally land a lucrative gig?
"Extraordinary and Exhilarating Beetle Battle Brawl"?

talks.objective: Head to the grounds where the "Extreme Beetle Brawl" will take place

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Not bad! Mamoru and Akira have delivered the goods. Let's start setting this baby up!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The highly experienced construction crew builds the arena...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahahahahaha! Now this is what I call an arena! Lookin' prett-ay good!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Boo yeah, compadre! I didn't know you were so handy with this kind of thing!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: And this awesome poster I made is the cherry on top! It captures the mood perfectly! Ahahahahahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Akira
dialogues.text: #Great carpentry, {NICKNAME}! And great artwork, Boss!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This place seems pretty far from Inazuma City. You sure anyone's gonna show up to watch?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: You bet they will! When you're as famous as I am, people will flock to watch you!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I heard this is the spot where they held the sword-fighting contest during the Irodori Festival. That makes this the ideal venue for Onikabuto duels!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Next up, time to show you my invincible Onikabuto, "Crimson Staff."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, it really is a red Onikabuto! Amazing!

choices.text: It's as if it's imbued with Pyro...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh. Paimon didn't expect you to put in this much effort. Where did you find this Onikabuto, anyway?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Can Paimon take a closer look?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Haha! Go ahead, feast your eyes! But I'm afraid I can't tell you what makes Crimson Staff such a special specimen. That's my little secret!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? That smells so familiar, what is that... wait, Valberry Jam?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: What! You're imagining things! You must be, like, super hungry, or something!

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: Speaking of which, Boss, you haven't applied a protective coating on top of the war paint yet, right? If it rains, then the 9,000 Mora we spent on the imported jam is gonna go to waste...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Don't worry! The "Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl" hasn't started yet. There's still time to give Crimson Staff one last layer of protective coating.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Alright, you guys go grab some flyers and start bringing in the crowds. In the meantime, I'll be helping my compadre and Flying Lavender Melon here get up to speed.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: After that, we'll celebrate over a meal. Ah, so much going on, I've really got my work cut out for me today, whew...

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: This your venue? Not bad... bigger than I expected.

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: It's Grandmaster Hanakado! He's here!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Wait, what? You're not supposed to know about this place yet!

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Aren't you forgetting something, Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King? We elite beetle fighters can sense each other's presence... or how else would we have crossed paths last time?

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Looks to me like you're still busy frantically preparing... is that because you don't have a clue how to beat us?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Pff! N—No...! Uh... In case you didn't know, me and my Onikabuto gotta get our brainwaves in sync before a battle, and until we're ready to roll, I always conserve my energy and keep a low profile!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: I just underestimated the strength of your beetle-battler sixth sense is all!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? So that's the kid Itto lost to? Yeah, he does look pretty normal...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But the way he talks is pretty unique. It almost feels like... he was born to be Bull-Chucker's archnemesis!

choices.text: Actually, I reckon they get along pretty well...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Grandmaster Hanakado! You did well to track me down, I'm impressed. Looks like this Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King needs to watch out for pretenders to the throne.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: But you're about to regret showing up here uninvited, because you have just earned yourselves a pre-beetle-brawl trouncing!

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Good, you seem more confident this time. And it sounds like you actually have a game plan.

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: But if I crushed you right away, I'd miss out on all the fun... so, I'll let my subordinates play with you first.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hmph! Using your minions to size up the competition now?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Then we'll send out Flying Lavender...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ahem! Nope, if Flying Lavender Melon's representing the Arataki Gang, we gotta rise to the occasion! We'll need a better title...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Got it, we'll send Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon out to teach you a lesson!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh!? Why Paimon?

choices.text: Will it be a Speed-Type Paimon?

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: Boss! Are we seriously going to fight them right now?

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: We haven't had time to spread the news about the match yet. Also, your compadre and your compadre's melon haven't even tried beetle fighting before.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: You make a good point! But the fact is, the kid's here now, and I ain't about to back down! We'll have to put the publicity side of things on hold for now.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: As for beetle-fighting techniques, I'll be mentoring Flying Lavender Melon... No, no, Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon, from the side! Battling's the best way to learn! Doesn't matter if you lose!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Why are you assuming that Paimon will lose before it's even started?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Go, White-Iron Lavender Melon! Show 'em the might of the Arataki Gang!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Sending you out first is part of my elaborate strategy, y'know! I got my inspiration from a Liyue tale that Shinobu told me!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: "Face their strongest with your weakest, their weakest with your average, and their average with your strongest. Then you're guaranteed to win two out of three rounds!"

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: You may be talented, but you lack practical battle experience. With all the elite beetle battlers here, I'm afraid to say you're a small fry.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: By sending a dopey little melon up first, we can get one of their best fighters to waste all their strength on the low-flying fruit, hahaha! We'll make short work of them this time!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um. But according to your logic, if you're planning to face their leader, Grandmaster Hanakado... doesn't that make YOU our weakest fighter?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Huh!? That can't be right...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Gah... you little twerp! I never said my strategy was EXACTLY the same as the one in the story!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Fine, fine, fine, Paimon'll do it already. But prepare to eat your words, mister!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Low-flying fruit, hm? Paimon'll show you!

choices.text: Or a Defense-Type Paimon?
We should let them catch up for a bit first...
It sure does have a unique aura...

dialogues.speaker: Elyctra
dialogues.text: What a puny opponent... And what a garish Onikabuto...

dialogues.speaker: Elyctra
dialogues.text: Pathetic! You can paint your Onikabuto any color you want... the only thing that counts in battle is their Electro affinity — the source of their power.

dialogues.speaker: Elyctra
dialogues.text: Being able to pick out a prize Onikabuto from the crowd is all that matters. That's what makes or breaks every beetle-fighter!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's a strange theory... Even Paimon knows that performance in battle matters the most. Honing your beetle-fighting skills is the most important thing!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: That's exactly right, mini melon!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Nice-sounding theory, but it ain't gonna help you if you don't know how to fight!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Listen up, White-Iron Lavender Melon. You need to watch your opponent's Onikabuto closely, so you can dodge its attacks. Then, in the opening right afterward, you strike back!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: As long as the opponent is in range, Crimson Staff will hit 'em hard!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Got it! So when the opponent attacks, we get our Onikabuto to retreat, and when there's an opening, we move it forward and strike while they're still recovering!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Sounds simple enough. Paimon will give it a go! {NICKNAME} heard the explanation too, so Paimon bets we're both ready for battle!

dialogues.speaker: Elyctra
dialogues.text: Are you seriously learning beetle fighting right before a match? You underestimate who you're up against!

dialogues.speaker: Elyctra
dialogues.text: Enough talk. Put your Onikabuto on the table and show me what you've got!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, piece of cake! You don't mess with this White-Iron Lavender Melon!

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru and Akira
dialogues.text: Amazing, mini melon!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Whoa! Who-ho-ho-hoa! Pretty talented, ain'cha? You sure showed them who's boss!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: You, my little friend, have earned yourself an Egg Roll later today.

choices.text: You're so strong, Paimon!

response.speaker: Elyctra
response.text: Ah, "Grandmaster Hanakado," I lost to a complete novice... I have let you down!

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Don't worry. It seems that they are a force to be reckoned with... We should inform the other generals to prepare for battle.

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: You defy my expectations once again, Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King... I didn't expect you to find such formidable warriors so quickly.

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: From today onward, I will send one of my generals here daily to face you.

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Be sure that you survive until the final battle. Otherwise, your declaration of war will become the laughingstock of the entire beetle-fighting world.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Wait just a minute. Leaving so soon? What are you, scared?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Gah, he's so annoying. Turning up here uninvited, talking to us in that smug tone, then taking off before we're done with him...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: From what Grandmaster Hanakado said, seems like he's gonna send some of his minions to challenge us. Guess we'll have another battle before too long, huh?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: That's right. Looks like we won't have time to make the Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl the grandest event ever organized by the Arataki Gang...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Meh, works for me! An audience would've been sweet, but at the end of the day, we came here to battle, and battling is what we're gonna do!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Look at you, Flying... ahem! Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon... defeating your first powerful enemy, starting to make a name for yourself as a fighter... Really gets me into the fighting spirit!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Gets me thinking about myself, back in the day, when I first entered the Hanamizaka beetle-battling scene... taking on the pros for the first time...

choices.text: I'm sure you had your fighting spirit...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, so did you also take down an expert when you first started, Bull-Chucker?

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: The Boss got brutally beaten...

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: I think Boss is saying he was inspired by White-Iron Lavender Melon's performance because he himself was defeated back in the day.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: C'mon, that's all in the past now! Spilled milk! Water under the bridge!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: #It's up to the three of us now. Me, the Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King, Paimon, the Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon, and {NICKNAME}, the... the Oni King's Right Hand!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: The three of us have to unite to take down Grandmaster Hanakado and all his minions!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Before we face each opponent, we need to talk strategy. As long as we win more matches than we lose, Grandmaster Hanakado will have to face me personally!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Bull-Chucker seems to be taking this all pretty seriously...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, that beetle fight was pretty fun, and we do get two months' worth of free ramen if we help him win this. Let's go along with it and do our best!

choices.text: You still haven't seen me in action.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hahahahahaha! That's what I'm talkin' about! Just follow my lead and give your all in battle. Grandmaster Hanakado's about to get more than he bargained for!

choices.text: I want to show my stuff too.
...But you didn't exactly make a name for yourself back then, did you?
Your opponent was weak!
